what_i_did: Copied models/apple-tree (build.py, hero_check.py, run.sh) and reshaped it. Same conventions: Z up, metres, origin at the trunk base on the ground, front -Y, yaw 0, hero_check at 8 deg elevation, no variants (tree group), same material names and roles (Bark_Brown, Leaf_Dark, Leaf_Light, Fruit_Red, Grass_Green). No new materials.

make_views.py uses the saturation key from models/maple-charming (keep saturated bark and leaf pixels, largest piece, clamp rows that suddenly widen at the foot), which keys out the long cast shadow and the cream floor; the thin grass disc under the hero survives as a sliver.

A chubbier 9-sided rope-twisted tube (radius 0.24 to 0.15 m against 0.17 to 0.12) along a taller S measured on the hero (right at the foot, left at 1.4 m, back over the base at the 1.8 m fork), a fat root flare, three rounded root toes on the pad, and five chunky round-tipped limbs fanning from a swollen fork.

The normal's domed surface of tufts and 330 leaf cards replaced by 14 plump smooth-shaded cloud clumps (squashed icospheres, flatter underneath), three of them with a smaller puff riding on top, placed from the hero's clump layout: a lopsided crown with low lobes hanging on both sides and the mass a little right of the foot, so the tree leans. Depth clumps fill the back and front so the footprint stays round.

Eight raised cinnamon-roll spiral ridges projected onto the upward-facing clump surfaces, in the contrasting green (dark swirl on a light clump and the reverse): the hero's swirling cloud leaves, readable from the game's elevated camera.

Fewer, bigger, proud apples (13 on the crown plus 4 hanging under the side lobes, 0.30 to 0.34 m across against 0.26 to 0.32), squat with a dimpled top, a stubby stem each and a little leaf on every third, sitting half out of the clumps.

2,985 triangles (budget 3k), 9 meshes, flat base colours, smooth shading. 4.19 m tall, footprint 3.38 x 3.26 m (normal 3.57 x 3.55, width/depth 1.04 against 1.01). to_game.py apple-tree-charming installs it at simulations/regional-assets-charming/GF-153.glb.
good: Hero silhouette IoU 0.823, as good as the normal model's 0.824: the lopsided cloud crown, the tall S trunk and the hanging apples line up.
Reads at a glance as the same apple tree, now a soft toy: chunky trunk, round puffs, big apples.
Footprint proportions kept (width/depth 1.04), so it drops in for the normal model.
off: The sheet's three trees are much taller and narrower (height/width 1.67 to 1.94 against the hero's 1.20), with an apple heap on top of the crown and a pink bark, so they are not views of the hero's tree. The hero wins, which caps the sheet views at about 0.48 to 0.54; the sheet's side view drops further because the crown is kept round in depth to match the normal footprint.
The hero's clumps are many small swirled lobes; within 3k triangles each clump is one or two low-poly puffs, so the silhouettes are polygonal close up and only 8 swirls are modelled.
The hero shows about 20 apples and visible limbs under the crown; my limbs are mostly hidden by the lowered clumps.
The grass sprout leaf at the hero's trunk foot is a small two-blade sprout, too small to read in the tile.

rounds.change: First charming build: hero-measured S trunk, 14 lumpy UV-sphere clumps, 14 spiral swirls, 28 apples with leaves. Faceted cabbage-like clumps, pale greens, 5,010 tris.
Clumps as smooth icosphere puffs (+3 top puffs), deeper greens, fewer apples, slimmer limbs and roots; 3,058 tris.
Right lobes pushed out, hanging apples raised, fatter lower trunk bulging right, bigger swirls; 13 crown apples for the budget (2,972 tris).
Swirls projected onto the clump spheres and placed on upward faces, bigger apples set prouder of the clumps.
Crown deepened front and back to keep the normal's round footprint (3.38 x 3.26 m), roots clamped to the ground, open stems; final 768 px / 48 sample render and score (2,985 tris).

moving_parts: None. The game poses and recolours the tree itself (leaf and grass materials follow the seasons).
creative_additions: Cinnamon-roll swirls on the clumps, a little leaf on some apple stems, rounded root toes on the grass pad and a two-leaf sprout at the foot.
